description: a vertical cylindrical chemical storage tank with a domed roof, a ladder up the side, a railing on top and two flanged pipe nozzles at the base, standing on a 3x3 tile footprint. Off-white steel with grey bands and orange accent stripes.

a groundwater well pump station on a 2x2 tile footprint: a squat electric pump house with a motor on top, a concrete pad, a vertical pipe going into the ground and one flanged outlet pipe. Blue painted steel.

a natural-gas wellhead on a 2x2 tile footprint: a tall 'Christmas tree' stack of red valves and handwheels on a concrete cellar, pressure gauges, one flanged outlet pipe. Red and yellow painted steel.
an air intake filter house on a 2x2 tile footprint: a boxy louvred filter housing with a fan blower and a flanged outlet duct. Pale green painted steel.
a single centrifugal process pump on a 1x1 tile footprint: an electric motor coupled to a volute pump casing on a steel skid, flanged inlet and outlet. Blue motor, dark grey casing.

a reciprocating gas compressor on a 2x2 tile footprint: a large electric motor driving horizontal cylinders with flywheel, pulsation bottles and flanged suction and discharge pipes. Dark green and grey.

a fired steam boiler on a 3x3 tile footprint: a brick-lined furnace box with a burner port on the front, a horizontal steam drum on top, a tall riveted chimney stack, and pipe nozzles. Dark red brick and black steel, glowing orange burner window.

a steam turbine generator set on a 3x3 tile footprint: a horizontal turbine casing with a large steam inlet pipe, coupled to an electric generator with cooling fins, on a heavy steel base. Green turbine casing, grey generator.
an air-cooled steam condenser on a 3x3 tile footprint: an A-frame of finned tube bundles over large horizontal fans on a steel support frame, with a steam header pipe. Galvanised grey steel.

a steam methane reformer furnace on a 4x4 tile footprint: a tall refractory-lined box furnace with rows of vertical catalyst tubes visible through inspection windows glowing orange, burner ports along the sides, inlet and outlet headers and a convection section with a stack. Light grey with orange heat glow.

a water-gas shift reactor on a 2x2 tile footprint: a tall vertical pressure vessel with hemispherical heads, a support skirt, catalyst loading manway, insulation cladding and inlet/outlet nozzles. Aluminium-clad silver.

a Haber-Bosch ammonia converter on a 3x3 tile footprint: a very thick-walled tall high-pressure vessel with forged bolted closure on top, heavy studs, an internal heat-exchanger nozzle and a separate small loop cooler. Dark blue-grey forged steel.
a methanol synthesis reactor on a 2x2 tile footprint: a vertical tubular boiling-water reactor with a steam drum mounted beside it, insulated, with flanged nozzles. Purple-grey steel.

an ethane steam-cracking furnace on a 3x3 tile footprint: a tall narrow radiant firebox with serpentine coils glowing red-hot behind windows, a transfer-line quench exchanger, and a stack. Dark grey steel with red-hot glow.

a vertical flash separator drum on a 2x2 tile footprint: a tall vertical vessel with a mist-eliminator top, a level gauge glass on the side, a vapour outlet at the top and a liquid outlet at the bottom on a skirt. Yellow painted steel.

a shell-and-tube heat exchanger on a 2x2 tile footprint: a horizontal cylindrical shell on two saddles with a bolted channel head, four flanged nozzles (two on top, two on the head). Grey steel with red and blue nozzle bands.
an industrial electric process heater on a 2x2 tile footprint: a steel cabinet with a large terminal box, heavy cable conduits, a heating element bundle flange and warning stripes. Orange and black.

a flare stack on a 1x1 tile footprint: a tall thin steel stack with a guy-wired lattice support, a flare tip with a bright yellow-orange flame at the top and a knockout drum at the base. Red and white striped stack.
a small atmospheric vent on a 1x1 tile footprint: a short vertical pipe with a weather hood, a relief valve and a flange. Grey steel with a yellow valve.
a large manual gate valve in a horizontal pipe on a 1x1 tile footprint: a bonnet with a big red handwheel on top, bolted flanges at both ends. Grey steel and red handwheel.
a ground-mounted solar panel array on a 2x2 tile footprint: tilted dark blue photovoltaic panels on a galvanised steel rack with an inverter box.
an industrial battery energy storage unit on a 2x2 tile footprint: a container-like steel enclosure with louvres, cooling unit on top, high-voltage terminals and a status light panel. White and teal.
a medium wooden electric power pole on a 1x1 tile footprint with a cross arm, ceramic insulators and three wires stubs. Dark brown wood, grey insulators.

an alkaline water electrolyser on a 3x3 tile footprint: a long stack of electrolysis cells clamped between end plates, gas separator drums for hydrogen and oxygen on top, cable busbars. Light blue and white.
